sugyot.title_en: Rav Papa: the half-damages payment of an innocuous ox is MAMONA -- monetary restitution for the injured party's loss
the animal is not muad to crouch [on vessels] -- revitza is keren's tolada, so it pays half damages

since it teaches 'the tooth is muad to eat', the clause must speak of the injured party's courtyard (shen is exempt in the public domain) -- and 'the animal is not muad' there means it pays half for the unusual
דומיא דרגל: as regel is liable whether or not the object's substance is destroyed, so shen is liable whether or not the substance is consumed
if shen, whose object is not to damage, is liable, then keren, whose object is to damage, all the more so
Goring should be derivable from the common factor of two other written categories (with Pit among them)
derive the stone/knife/load (at rest, ownerless) from Pit alone
'sadeh' is stated below and stated above: as the field above is the injured party's, so the field below -- assessment follows the nizak
'ישיב' comes to include payment in anything worth money, even bran
is the third reckoned from within (a third of the base cost added) or from without (a third of the total outlay)?
